description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Axebane Guardian.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Axebane Guardian.
Repeat.
